$description: GlassPanel component contract — Obsidian Glass recipe (spec §9).

text.$description: Ink for text that lands on a GlassPanel surface. Defaults to text.primary (dark canon: light ink on obsidian glass). Light shells (alice) override to dark ink so re-themed dark-persona screens (which flip text.primary light) do not paint light-on-light over the light glass substrate. This is the W3 structural-contrast role token (NEXUS W3-structural-contrast, variant B).

edge.$comment: inner top highlight — glass edge catch-light (visual-3)

topbarText.$description: Ink for topbar search-pill and opacity-control labels (topSearch/opacityLabel). Defaults to text.primary (dark canon: ivory ink on obsidian glass). Light shells (alice) override to dark ink so the labels read on the light topbar glass. REAL-BUGS (alice contrast, topSearch 1.11:1 / opacityLabel 1.29:1) — token-level close per 0930ba29 pattern, no scoped-CSS override, no hardcode.

topbarTextDim.$description: Muted ink for topbar value chips / kbd hints. Follows the text ramp so a light shell re-points the muted step without a second override.
